objective: Prevent a design or conceptual AR from entering Coordinator promotion without an exact, passing formal specification result.
assumptions: Coordinator remains authoritative for task lifecycle mutation
The product formal checker is available locally and uses no network
Operational ARs may use the lighter bounded specification path
unknowns: An upstream Coordinator hook may later replace the project adapter
invariants: Design/conceptual promotion requires a specification reference
The specification digest is computed from the referenced artifact
The formal check binds to the same specification identity, version, method, and task revision
Missing, stale, failed, timed-out, or inconclusive evidence rejects promotion
The adapter never mutates Coordinator state directly
acceptance_predicates: A valid design/conceptual task reaches Coordinator promote only after all evidence checks pass
A non-pass formal result is rejected
An operational task follows the bounded operational path
Coordinator remains the only lifecycle writer

formalization.checker: tools/check_spec.py plus state-repository promotion adapter tests
formalization.scope: bounded preflight states for one task and one promotion attempt
